findings.summary: The right-triangle formulas used shortened Nynorsk side labels instead of the established motståande side and hosliggjande side terms.
evidence: The explanatory text used motståande side and hosliggjande side while the formulas omitted side.
findings.resolution: Expanded all three visible formulas to the established Nynorsk side terminology.

findings.summary: The inverse-trigonometry formulas used shortened Nynorsk side labels that differed from the surrounding explanation.

findings.summary: The worked trigonometry example used abbreviated side labels instead of the terms used in the Nynorsk explanation.
